items.question: Does watermark removal reduce image quality?
items.answer: No — MediaClaw accesses the original source files, not screenshots. Images and videos are downloaded at their native resolution with full detail preserved.

items.question: Can I batch-download all images from a single post?
items.answer: Yes. Open any post detail page and download all images in one click — no need to save each one individually.

items.question: Are video downloads also watermark-free?
items.answer: Yes. Video files are downloaded in their original format and quality, ready for local archiving and content analysis.

items.question: What's the recommended use for downloaded assets?
items.answer: Use for visual reference, competitive analysis, content breakdowns, and creative inspiration. We don't recommend republishing others' content as-is — respect original creators' work.
